name: Telluria
storyline:
"I woke up after 200 years and YOU WERE GONE, ALL MY WORLD WAS GONE. Who am I, Father ?"
"You are my daughter, my beloved spark. And you are way more than this"

Two heroines—Annelise Leigh of Augusta and Annelise, daughter to Caden and Kyra Leigh —live more than a thousand years apart in two separate realities within the same world—connected yet entirely independent, where events unfold simultaneously across a cosmic spiral of time.
The First Age, a dark fantasy land of myths, sanctuaries, and raw elemental power, and the Third Age, a cold, slightly cyberpunk future shaped by machines, fading knowledge, and forgotten history.
Through the powers of the Pyrite Talisman, a relic capable of piercing the boundaries of time, their parallel paths begin to converge. As ancient forces awaken and the first signs of the Great Plagues reappear, both Annelises must confront a fractured reality: their twin existence is the key to reconciling a split world before time runs out.
summary: One Soul. Two Lives. Separated by 1400 Years. Unravel an ancient prophecy in a 3D narrative adventure spanning two different eras where an entire reality is at stake. When they finally find each other, you will decide what survives — and at what cost.
